## Unordered lists

- Short unordered item.
- Long unordered item with **bold text** and *italic text* that continues well beyond the available width so it wraps onto multiple lines and verifies that every continuation aligns beneath the item text.

## Ordered lists

9. Short ordered item.
10. Long ordered item with **bold text** that continues well beyond the available width so its continuation lines align beneath the text after a two-digit enumeration marker.
11. Ordered list item with nested unordered bullets
    * One
    * Two

## Task lists

- [x] Short checked task.
- [x] Long checked task with *italic text* that continues beyond the available width so wrapped continuation lines align beneath the checked task text.
- [ ] Short unchecked task.
- [ ] Long unchecked task with **bold text** that continues beyond the available width so wrapped continuation lines align beneath the unchecked task text.

## Nested lists

- Short parent item.
    - Long nested item with *styled content* that continues beyond the nested list width so every wrapped continuation aligns beneath the nested item text.
        1. Long ordered grandchild item with **bold content** that continues beyond the narrower grandchild width so its continuation lines retain both nesting and hanging indentation.
        2. Short ordered grandchild item.
    - [ ] Long nested unchecked task that continues beyond the nested list width so its wrapped continuation lines align beneath the complete checkbox.
    - Short nested item.
- Final short parent item.
- Deeply nested list
  - A second level
    - And yet a third
      - And a fourth
        1. Deeply nested numbered list
        2. A second item
- Now we implicitly end all previous levels and there should not be any superfluous blank lines

## Loose list items

- A loose list item whose first paragraph is long enough to wrap onto another line and verify the initial hanging indentation.

  Its second paragraph is also long enough to wrap onto another line and verify that every line remains aligned beneath the first paragraph's text.
- A loose list item with text before a nested list.

    - A short nested item between two paragraphs.

  The paragraph after the nested list is long enough to wrap onto another line and verify that mixed block content retains the parent item's hanging indentation.

## Embedded blocks

- A loose list item with text before a blockquote.

  > A blockquote between two paragraphs that is long enough to wrap onto another line and verify that its marker and continuation text remain inside the parent item's hanging indentation.

  The paragraph after the blockquote is long enough to wrap onto another line and verify that block output preserves one paragraph separator and the parent item's hanging indentation.
- A loose list item with text before a fenced code block.

  ```text
  code between two paragraphs
  ```

  The paragraph after the fenced code block is long enough to wrap onto another line and verify that code output preserves one paragraph separator and the parent item's hanging indentation.
10. An ordered list item with text before a fenced code block.

    ```go
    func Foo() int {
        return 42
    }
    ```

    The paragraph after the ordered code block verifies that the code and prose align beneath the wider ordered marker.
11. An ordered list item with text before a table.

    | First column | Second column |
    | --- | --- |
    | A table inside an ordered item | Its width accounts for the ordered marker |

    The paragraph after the table verifies that the table and prose align beneath the wider ordered marker.
12. A nested unordered list with an embedded table and code block
    * Some irrelevant first bullet, but also testing with asterisks instead of dashes
    * A second bullet with another nesting level
      * And then a code block below the triple-level nested bullet:
        ```go
        type Foo struct {
          Bar string
        }
        ```
    * A third bullet with an embedded table:
      | First column | Second column |
      | --- | --- |
      | A [table](https://example.com/table) inside a nested item | Its width accounts for every parent marker |
- A loose list item with text before an HTML block.

  <div>HTML between two paragraphs that is long enough to wrap onto another line and verify that direct HTML block content retains the parent item's hanging indentation.</div>

  The paragraph after the HTML block is long enough to wrap onto another line and verify that HTML output preserves one paragraph separator and the parent item's hanging indentation.
